newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy household confidence index rises in January.
newsitem.headline: Italy household confidence index rises in January.

text.p: Confidence in the economy among Italian households continued to improve in January, economic research institute Isco said in its latest survey.
Isco's January confidence index (1980=100) rose to 109.9 from December's 105.3 to post the first monthly increase since August. A year ago, the index stood at 109.7.

"The phase of sharply worsening expectations seen in autumn seems to have been overcome," Isco said, adding that families were less apprehensive about the economy looking ahead over the next 12 months.

There were some signs households expected to spend a bit more on durable goods or on a new car over the next year, but Isco saw no increase in the number of families aiming to spend money on buying a new house or on major repairs to an existing one. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
